newsitem.title: USA: Air South names new president, acting chairman.
newsitem.headline: Air South names new president, acting chairman.

text.p: Air South Airlines Inc said it has named John Affeltranger president and acting chairman after its Chairman, Chief Executive and President John Tague resigned.
Affeltranger is the chief operating officer of the privately-held airline.

The company did not say why Tague, who had headed the company since August 1996, resigned. However, the company said he had led the airline while it sought to strengthen its infrastructure and expand its marketing.

"For the past 10 months, John Tague has taken the helm at Air South and plotted a course towards recovery," said Bill Hambrecht of Hambrect & Quist, a major investor in Air South. "We are pleased with Air South's continued progress and remain supportive of everyone's efforts."
Affeltranger joined Air South in August of 1996 as senior vice president and was later named chief operating officer.
Air South, which began service in August 1994, is a domestic airline based in Columbia, S.C.
